items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The transcript mentions 'Army' only in the context of the interviewee's service ('before you went in the Army'), not as a person.

ctx.x: I just remember Fats Waller from that area. I did a tune by him, “Hold Tight,” and “Foo-ra-de-ack-a-sa-ki. Want some seafood, Mama.” I played it at the high school auditorium, and I lost the contest...
To the guy who played “The Washington and Lee...” Now, before you went in the
Army, you spent a year or six months at University of Mississippi.
